_doc: Chain definition for vina_virtual_screening_bench (workstream B2). Applied by backend/scripts/add_vina_bench_chain.py. Scenario: docs/20261101_VINA_SCREENING_CHAIN_BENCH_SCENARIO.md (EGFR kinase, PDB 1M17). Every hand-off below is justified from the workflows' own main.nf (paths relative to backend/biomni_workflows/nextflow_nfcore/subworkflows/). 'workflow_file' on a step is a pin check only (stripped before insert). 'evidence' on a connection is informational (stripped before insert).
name: vina_virtual_screening_bench
description: Structure-based hit finding on a characterised target (bench scenario: EGFR kinase domain, PDB 1M17): druggable-pocket detection, pharmacophore pre-screen of a compound library against known actives, ADMET profiling of the surviving compounds, then AutoDock Vina docking into the detected pocket with the pharmacophore-filtered compounds. Note: the ADMET step reports properties but does not remove compounds before docking (it publishes no compound list).

connections.evidence: pocket_detection_druggability publishes <PDBID>_pockets.json (emit pocket_json, main.nf:75; written main.nf:193-203) with pockets[].center_x/center_y/center_z, volume_A3, druggability_score sorted best-first. docking_autodock_vina declares box_center as an inline JSON '[x,y,z]' (main.nf:10,43,111,270) and box_size likewise (main.nf:11). The file path cannot be parsed as '[x,y,z]', so the registered transform extracts the top pocket; it also returns box_size, which the executor must apply to the declared box_size param. The substring 'pockets.json' matches only the pockets report (not _top_pocket.pdb, not the QC json).

pharmacophore_filtering publishes filtered_compounds.smi (emit filtered_smiles, main.nf:388; lines '<smiles>  <compound_id>', main.nf:407-409). predict_admet_properties declares smiles_list as an inline JSON array (main.nf:21; JsonSlurper main.nf:844-845; json.loads of PARAM_SMILES_LIST main.nf:48), so the file needs the transform.

Same artifact feeds docking_autodock_vina.smiles_list (inline JSON array, main.nf:8,41,84). Docking takes the pharmacophore-filtered list directly because predict_admet_properties publishes only predict_admet_properties_results.json, _output.txt, toxicity_report.json, pk_summary.json and qc_metrics.json (main.nf:108-112): no compound list, so an ADMET-passed list cannot be handed on.

required_inputs.name: reference_actives
required_inputs.description: Known EGFR actives (SMILES file path or inline SMILES, one per line) that define the pharmacophore; required by pharmacophore_filtering (main.nf:55,533)

required_inputs.name: compound_library
required_inputs.description: Library to screen: actives plus property-matched decoys (SMILES or SDF); required by pharmacophore_filtering (main.nf:56,536)

expected_outputs.name: docking_autodock_vina_results
expected_outputs.description: Per-ligand best Vina affinity (kcal/mol) and poses count; the ranking input for enrichment (AUROC, EF1%)

expected_outputs.name: pockets_report
expected_outputs.description: Detected pockets with druggability score, volume and centre; the top pocket defines the docking box

expected_outputs.name: admet_report
expected_outputs.description: ADMET predictions, toxicity report and PK summary for the pharmacophore-filtered compounds
